decisions.rationale: Live's standard notification API; replaces previous text. set_status_text would conflict with Live's own status messages.

decisions.decision: Centralized StatusBarMessenger helper class, dependency-injected via constructor messenger=None kwarg
decisions.rationale: Default-None on every constructor kwarg means each task lands as an independent atomic commit; rollback at any point leaves a working script.

decisions.decision: Hardware-side value listeners (not param.add_value_listener) for parameter-value messages
decisions.rationale: Param listeners fire on Live-UI changes too. Hardware-side listeners fire only when MIDI arrives from the APC40 — matches user intent ('when I turn the cutoff'). Resolves planner gotcha #3.
decisions.scope: make_hardware_value_callback factory + per-component param-message listener bookkeeping

decisions.decision: 50ms time-based debounce keyed by id(param), 200ms identical-text dedup, 2s cold-start silence
decisions.rationale: Encoder turns generate ~100 events/sec. Without throttling Live would log-spam; without cold-start silence the bootup floods the bar with initial-value messages from every component setup.

decisions.decision: Pan16DeviceComponent (16-macro Pan-mode encoders) param messages OUT OF SCOPE for this task
decisions.rationale: Pan16 has its own encoder bookkeeping that doesn't easily share the make_hardware_value_callback factory. Adding it would expand scope. Documented as Phase 6 follow-up TODO in user manual.

context_notes: Today (2026-05-05): closed out two big quick tasks (k6p AutoFilter LFO T Mode, m2x Drum Rack Mode — both required 4-round post-UAT debug sessions). Now landed sb9 (status bar messages) which is cross-cutting across 7 components but small per-component (~mostly listener bookkeeping). Three lessons reinforced this session and applied throughout sb9: (1) silent-failure modes — connect_to(None), get_parameter_by_name miss, turn_on() last-sent cache short-circuit — all fail invisibly; instrument with log_message before assuming success. (2) hardware addressability is firmware-version-dependent — Stop All Clips LED is hardware-only on APC40 mk1; Detail View LED works. Indicator design must verify the LED responds to Live's own writes during normal use. (3) For enum-driven param routing, dump value_items via diagnostic before guessing — the AutoFilter2 LFO T Mode 6-vs-4 mismatch caught us in two extra rounds. Project still on v1.2 Documentation milestone Phase 6 (create-user-manual) per STATE.md — these quick tasks are feature work that Phase 6 will document. After sb9 UAT-passes, the natural next step is /clear then /gsd-execute-phase 6 to resume the milestone.
